records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for the pagination question earlier "" to confirm, list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, and your ticket on that is now closed. If anything there is still unclear, I'm happy to dig in.

It was good to have the kickoff last week. The natural next step is getting your first project in place "" projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. From there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'll work through the first project with you.

Best,
Tariq
